text:
Robert Pattinson, reportedly the next James Bond, is a Jaeger-LeCoultre global ambassador since September 2026 (per Hypebeast).

The watch in this post: Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control Q4158120, listed at USD 14,200 by Watches of Switzerland on 21 November 2026. Retailer prices can change, so check before you buy.

Pattinson showed a rose-gold Master Control at the Oscars, per Hypebeast. We are not saying he wears the Q4158120 in the photo.

Would you wear the Master Control Q4158120 or pass? Comment below.

Source: Deadline (25 November 2026); Hypebeast (2 September 2026); Watches of Switzerland (21 November 2026). Photo: Jaeger-LeCoultre, via Hypebeast.
